meta.title: FEAT-002 · Profile and preferred language
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: the components this slice builds or changes, the contract on every arrow, and the decisions behind them. Pick a flow to follow one use-case path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: A signed-in user opens the storefront profile page. The SPA calls the gateway BFF, which relays /v1/me/* to Identity with a bearer token. Identity validates the JWT itself, takes the user from sub, saves profile fields in identitydb and writes UserProfileChanged to the outbox when display name or language changed. After a save the SPA asks the BFF to force a token refresh so the session shows the new name and language. Service Bus delivers the event to Notification, which upserts the contact's language. The language switcher applies the locale in the browser at once and stores it in localStorage.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.desc: The signed-in user editing their profile or a visitor picking a language. Holds only the encrypted hs.bff cookie; never a token.

nodes.label: Storefront SPA
nodes.desc: features/profile/ (ProfilePage.vue, api.ts) at /profile, route meta requiresAuth. LanguageSwitcher in StorefrontLayout. Session store gains refresh(). Account menu gains "Profile".

nodes.label: localStorage
nodes.desc: core/i18n.ts setLocale writes hs-locale and <html lang>. The only store for a visitor's choice; for a signed-in user the profile wins on session load (D-7).

nodes.label: Gateway + BFF
nodes.desc: New route me: /v1/me/{**rest} → identity, policy authenticated. New POST /bff/session/refresh forces a refresh-token exchange via SessionTokens.ForceRefreshAsync (single-flight) and returns the /bff/user body.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.desc: First endpoint a service protects itself: OpenIddict local validation, audience hivespace-api, policy me (no cookie). Handlers GetMyProfile, UpdateMyProfile (collects every violation first), UpdateMyLanguage. Body read as JsonElement so email becomes a field error.

nodes.label: identitydb
nodes.desc: Migration AddUserProfile: display_name 60 → 80, add phone varchar(16), gender varchar(20) with ck_users_gender, date_of_birth date. No index.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: Outbox relay, at least once. Notification's subscription dispatches by eventType.

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.desc: features/contacts handles UserProfileChanged: validates against the v1 schema, upserts the contact. Inbox makes duplicates no-ops.

nodes.label: notificationdb
nodes.desc: No schema change: contacts (Alembic 0002) already holds display_name and language.

all.title: FEAT-002 design solution
all.intro: Six paths: view, edit, invalid input, switch language signed in, switch language as a visitor, and the auth guard.

steps.t: Relay with bearer; Identity validates the JWT and reads the user from sub.
Read the user; 200 Profile with avatarUrl: null (initials shown) and email read-only.
Save: PUT /v1/me/profile with all four fields; null clears an optional one.
One transaction: save, plus UserProfileChanged in the outbox only when the display name changed. 200 Profile.
Forced session refresh so the header name is current at once, not after 15 min (D-4).
Notification upserts the contact; a duplicate delivery is a no-op.
PUT with bad values (empty or 81-char name, phone 12345, unknown gender, future date, email key).
400 common.validation_failed with one details entry per field, all at once, in the request's language. Nothing is saved, no event.
Pick English: setLocale('en') switches the UI at once.
PUT /v1/me/profile/language {en}; fr → identity.language_unsupported. A failed save keeps the UI language and shows a toast.
Save; event only when the language changed (same value → 200, no event).
Refresh the session so /bff/user carries lang=en; another browser gets it on sign-in (D-7).
Contact language updated, so later emails are in English (FR-LOC-005).
Browser only: setLocale writes hs-locale; no request is sent.
Direct call with no token, a tampered token or another audience → Identity returns 401. A spoofed X-User-Id never selects the user.
On session load, when /bff/user language differs from the active locale, setLocale applies the profile's (D-7).

notes.b: Header name and language come from token claims that would be stale up to 15 min. Rejected: reading the profile on every /bff/user, and a response-header trigger.
OpenIddict UseLocalServer(), no JWKS fetch; the me policy never accepts the hs.idp cookie. Shared .NET validation comes with the first non-Identity protected endpoint.
Full replace of the four editable fields; language is a PUT on its own sub-resource. Enforced by Spectral hs-no-patch.
Column widened 60 → 80; registration follows the same rule.
Narrowing back to 60 is rejected by Postgres if a longer name exists; the rollback fails loudly instead of truncating.
One canonical +84… form for later uses (shipping, FEAT-022); no phone library for one country.

notes.t: Event carries only what consumers use
notes.b: Email, display name, language. Phone, gender and date of birth never leave Identity.
The FEAT-002 plan row says GET/PATCH /v1/me/profile; it should read GET/PUT /v1/me/profile, PUT /v1/me/profile/language. Owned by implementation-planning.
Avatar upload (FEAT-035), seller-centre language persistence (FEAT-009), masked public profile (FEAT-033).
Gateway BFF and token relay (FEAT-001 T8) before T6; Notification contacts and dispatcher (FEAT-001 T9) before T7.
